-- Best-selling products: at least 130 units
SELECT
  product_id,
  SUM(quantity) AS units,
  ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items
ORDER BY units DESC;
solution:
SELECT
  product_id,
  SUM(quantity) AS units,
  ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING SUM(quantity) >= 130
ORDER BY units DESC, product_id;
